items.statement: The computed subset supports a differentiated electronic/geometric explanation of Bergman-cyclization reactivity.
items.expected: EDY 16 is lower-barrier than EDY 15 and EDY 17; the paper attributes this to donor-to-acceptor through-bond charge-transfer stabilization, while EDY 17 is hindered by planarity loss and reactive-center charge accumulation. Electronic barriers need not reproduce DSC ordering exactly.
